in_marathi.name: Gayathri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of speech, wisdom, and knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gayathri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gayathri is a name of the Vedic Goddess of speech, wisdom, and knowledge. She is also revered as the embodiment of the sacred Gayathri mantra, which is chanted daily by millions of Hindus.
